_about: The game's prefabs looked at, level by level (tools/gen_prefab_recipes.py reads it): by game, 'reject' the assemblies that are not a whole structure (level/seed: an element of the assembly), 'names' the names given to some, 'kinds' what a kind found is called in a level (the farms' trees are orchard walls), 'max_size' the size a level's assemblies are cut at (whole blocks of the cities: 130 m, decisions keyed level@130/seed), 'per_level' how many assemblies to look at in a level (more where whole structures abound), 'reviewed' the levels looked at. Names only, no data of the game.

names.waspala/waspala-column-02-19: Spargus palace pillar with a palm
